newsitem.title: POLAND: Armstrong ups stake in Novita firm.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong ups stake in Novita firm.

text.p: A subsidiary of U.S.-based floor-products maker Armstrong World Industries has upped its stake in the retail trading subsidiary of Polish carpet maker Novita SA to 15.79 percent and will soon raise it to 30 percent, Novita said in a statement on Thursday.
Novita said that Armstrong Enterprises Inc had paid 1.6 million zlotys to up its stake in Novita Market SA to 15.79 percent.

The statement also said that by February 6 Novita would sell Armstrong another 450,000 shares in a 700,000-share Novita Market capital raise at 7.4 zlotys per share, giving Novita 70 percent of Novita Market and Armstrong 30 percent.
Earlier this month Armstrong Enterprises bought 10.5 percent of Novita Market, a chain of 50 shops and warehouses, for 3.2 million zlotys.

The statement said that from January 1, 1998, Novita Market would become the sole distributor in Poland of PCV carpets produced by Armstrong, with Novita Market authorised to use Armstrong's logo and expertise in distribution.
It said the deal did not foresee any capital links between Armstrong Enterprises and Novita SA.
